snippet.title: Embryogenesis Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
After a year of development, Embryogenesis is launching its playtest build.

Explore together in a world that Artificial Intelligence has eviscerated, where humanity has all but lost. Will you try to save us all, or will you finish the job?

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3903690/Embryogenesis/
